name: PyVista Analysis
description: Geometric analysis and attribute computation via PyVista: curvature estimation, distance computation, glyph generation, vector magnitude, and scalar statistics.

videos.title: Signals, 3D Point Clouds & Images: Features Analysis

theory.overview:
PyVista analysis tools compute derived geometric quantities:

**Curvature** estimates surface curvature (mean, Gaussian, min, max) at each vertex.
**Distance** computes point-to-surface distances between two meshes.
**Glyphs** visualize vector fields by placing oriented symbols at data points.
**Vector Magnitude** computes $\|\mathbf{v}\|$ for each vector in a field.
**Scalar Statistics** provides summary statistics of scalar arrays.

pv_curvature.title: Surface Curvature
pv_curvature.content: Curvature types: mean $H = \frac{\kappa_1 + \kappa_2}{2}$, Gaussian $K = \kappa_1 \kappa_2$, maximum $\kappa_1$, minimum $\kappa_2$.

pv_distance.title: Point-to-Surface Distance
pv_distance.content: Computes the closest-point distance from each vertex to a reference surface using a KD-tree.

pv_glyph.title: Glyph Generation
pv_glyph.content: Creates oriented arrow glyphs at each point, scaled by a factor and oriented along a vector field.

pv_vector_magnitude.title: Vector Magnitude
pv_vector_magnitude.content: Computes $\|\mathbf{v}_i\| = \sqrt{v_{ix}^2 + v_{iy}^2 + v_{iz}^2}$ for each vector and stores as a scalar.

pv_scalar_stats.title: Scalar Statistics
pv_scalar_stats.content: Computes min, max, mean, median, std, and stores a normalized version of the scalar array.

pv_extract_feature_edges.title: Feature Edge Extraction
pv_extract_feature_edges.content: Extracts edges where the surface normal changes sharply. A feature edge is identified when the dihedral angle between adjacent faces exceeds the threshold. Also detects boundary edges (single-face adjacency) and non-manifold edges (three or more face adjacency).

parameters.name: curvature_type
parameters.description: Curvature type: mean, gaussian, maximum, or minimum.

parameters.name: vector_name
parameters.description: Vector array to orient glyphs (e.g. Normals).

parameters.name: tolerance
parameters.description: Merge tolerance as fraction of bbox (-1 = auto/None).

parameters.name: absolute
parameters.description: Interpret tolerance as an absolute distance.

parameters.name: clamping
parameters.description: Clamp glyph scaling to the rng range.

parameters.name: vector_name
parameters.description: Name of the vector array to compute magnitude for.

parameters.name: feature_angle
parameters.description: Dihedral angle threshold for feature edge detection (degrees).

parameters.name: clear_data
parameters.description: Drop point/cell data arrays from the output edges.
